summary: FazerCards Phase 1 (POST /api/fazercards/pubg/validate-id) — full backend + frontend testing. All 14 pytest cases pass (test_fazercards_validate.py). Live curl confirms valid ID 5123456789 → 200 {valid:true, player_name:'Eliah2'}, invalid ID 999999999 → 200 {valid:false, message:'ID PUBG Mobile invalide'}, malformed → 422. Response never leaks secrets. Frontend UI flow works end-to-end: add-to-cart /produit/30-uc → /commande → pubg-id-input + pubg-verify-btn (disabled empty), valid ID → green box with player_name 'Eliah2' + confirm message, changing ID resets state, invalid ID → red box. Mobile 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow. Checkout form intact.

minor.issue: Upstream FazerCards intermittently returns 502 for unknown IDs; backend's 1-retry mostly hides it but ~1/3 requests during my testing still surface as Cloudflare 502. Retry logic already handles this; document expectation to users.

critical_code_review_comments: PubgIdVerify.js validates client-side pattern /^\d{9,13}$/ but backend allows 5..20 digits — mismatch is benign (frontend stricter) but could confuse users entering short/long legit IDs.
Response includes region:null when provider omits it — acceptable, but frontend already handles gracefully.
Rate limit 30/10min/IP is reasonable; no leak of X-API-Key / fzr.cards observed in any error path.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth required for validate-id endpoint
seed_data_creation: None. Used real product /produit/30-uc + localStorage cart via UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 (ID validation only) is stable. If Phase 2 (ordering) is added, DO NOT hit POST /topups/order live; mock provider. Existing 14 pytest cases in test_fazercards_validate.py cover discovery cache, retries, 502/504/429/401 mapping, secret leak prevention.
